meta.title: dsh-coding-time AI & Human Coding Activity (Local)
meta.description: Per-project coding activity time measured on this machine: active intervals from real session events and diff metadata, AI added/deleted lines from real diffs, and optional human-edit signals. Data never leaves this computer.

settings.title: Coding activity
settings.description: Everything is stored locally under ~/.dsh/coding-time. No account, no upload, no keys.
settings.enabledHint: Turn off to stop collecting entirely. Nothing is written while disabled.
settings.heartbeatIntervalSecondsHint: At most one new interval per project within this window. Evidence is never dropped.
settings.idleThresholdSecondsHint: Gaps longer than this break the segment. Must be at least the heartbeat window.
settings.flushIntervalSecondsHint: How often an in-memory checkpoint is written to disk. A crash can lose at most this much.
settings.trackAgentActivityHint: Only affects generic agent activity, never AI file/line evidence.
settings.trackAiLinesHint: Only counted from real diff metadata. Unknown stays unknown, never guessed.
settings.humanEnabledHint: Off by default: a file watcher cannot prove a human typed. Enable only if you provide an explicit signal.
settings.storageDirectoryHint: Absolute path on this machine. Credentials are never stored in the config.
settings.timezoneHint: IANA zone used for day/week boundaries.
settings.excludeHint: Relative patterns only. Matched files are still counted as evidence but never contribute lines.
